append.detail: The members page admits Operations and Support staff (requireAdmin janitor or staff members domain, ADR-223) but rendered every row action, and edit profile, send sign-in link, deactivate, reactivate and delete are web_role janitor server actions, so a staffer saw buttons that always threw Unauthorized; and handleRoleChange, handleDeactivate, handleReactivate and handleProfileSave awaited their action inside startTransition with no try/catch, so React 19 rethrew to app/(main)/admin/error.tsx and one click replaced the whole admin page (janitors hit it too on a duplicate handle or non-https avatar). Fix: page.tsx computes isJanitorViewer from isJanitor(caller.webRole) and passes canManageAccounts to MemberAdmin and each row; the four janitor-only buttons render only when it is true (Spotlight switches stay for every admitted staffer); the four handlers now catch and setStatus the error like their siblings, the status line renders errors in the danger style with role=alert, handleProfileSave closes the form only on success, and Deactivate got the same two-step confirm as Delete. Server gates untouched. Pinned by app/(main)/admin/members/member-admin.test.tsx: renders MemberAdmin with and without the flag and asserts the buttons, pins the page wiring and every handler's try/catch via sourceWithoutComments.
